name: Cycle padding sampler
plain: Wraps a sampler to pad the latent per model call inside a sigma window with a repeating size list, then unpad output. Possible padding modes include noise fills.
math: pad=sizes[counter % len], counter per model call in window. x_p=F.pad(x,pad,mode). noise modes: x_p+=(randn+mean_spatial(x_p))·mask, mask=σ or std on the pad, 0 inside. x0=unpad(model(x_p,σ)).
label: from code

audit.note: cycle_padding_sampler.py:92-93: the noise is (randn + spatial mean of x_p)·mask, not randn·mask. :70 advances the counter per model call inside the sigma window, not per step.
